dataset: Microsoft FinOps Toolkit demo FOCUS dataset
currency: USD, based on prior dataset inspection; verify currency_summary.csv
method: Screening flags records with unusually high log absolute BilledCost using a global IQR fence or a within-service IQR fence. Service-relative thresholds are only calculated for services with at least 30 records.
limitations: No labelled incidents are available; precision, recall, false-positive rate and accuracy cannot be calculated.
A flagged billing record is a cost outlier for investigation, not a confirmed incident, fraud event or billing error.
CPU, memory and application telemetry are not present in this billing dataset, so utilization-based anomalies are not tested.
Negative costs are retained and analyzed by magnitude; their business meaning is not inferred.
The thresholds are statistical screening rules and may require service-specific review before operational use.
